summary: Vivos Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing its intention to conduct a rights offering. The company plans to distribute transferable subscription rights as a dividend, each entitling the holder to purchase one share at an exercise price of the greater of $1.25 or 20% above market price on the day before the record date. Rights are listed and exercisable for nine months, with subsequent trading rights at the greater of $1.75 or 40% above market. The offering is subject to SEC effectiveness, exchange listing, shareholder approval for additional shares, and board approval. Monitor SEC clearance and market price relative to exercise price; risk-arb focuses on subscription take-up and dilution.
